Hi Elena — thanks for sending the form and the bank details. Couple quick items from our side: 

1) Redwood standard vendor terms are Net 30. We can request Net 45 for approved partners, but that requires a business justification and finance approval.
2) To move forward on a PO I need: W-9 (or W-8 if outside the US), full remit address to place on the PO, and your preferred invoice header (which invoice number format you’ll use).
3) For early pay: we do have an Accelerated Pay pilot that can be enabled case-by-case. Would you be asking Redwood to pay earlier (e.g., 10 days) or are you able to accept Net 30 and request early release for select invoices?

I’ve attached our PO template so finance can see the fields we’ll populate. Can you send the W-9 and confirm whether you want to be enrolled in the expedited-pay pilot (and if yes, what fee you are proposing or willing to accept)?

I’ll loop in Finance to evaluate Net 45 vs. Net 30 + expedite options after I get the W-9.

Thanks,

Hi Laura / Marissa — forwarding Atlas’s ask. TL;DR: AtlasMetrics wants Net 45 as standard but is asking to be enrolled in our Accelerated Pay for the first two invoices (10-day pay for a 1% fee). First two invoices estimated $18.4k and $12.9k. They asked if we could instead do Net 30 with early release options.

My recommendation: approve a limited pilot — 10-day payment for a 1% fee on the first two invoices, capped at $25k per invoice, and require the invoice to contain an "EXPEDITE" header so AP can route. After the two onboarding invoices they move to Net 30 (unless we approve Net 45 for other reasons). 

Questions for Finance:
- Can we honor a 1% fee for 10-day on a capped amount?
- What PO/GL code do we put on the PO for a pilot like this? Can we add a memo field to tag these as "expedite_pilot/AtlasMetrics" for audit?

I’ve summarized the proposal in the attached text file. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Rafael

Rafael / Marissa — reviewed. Approve the limited Accelerated Pay pilot under these conditions: 

- Terms: 10-day pay on the first two invoices only, fee = 1.0% (deducted from invoice), maximum per-invoice cap = $25,000.
- After pilot invoices, default to Net 30 for Redwood payments. We will not set Net 45 as default.
- Operational requirements: Atlas must include the PO number on invoices and the literal string "EXPEDITE" in the invoice header so AP routes to expedited queue.
- Accounting: use GL code 5-4320-99 (external contractors) and add memo tag "expedite_pilot/AtlasMetrics". AP will require a scanned W-9 (received) and vendor banking validation (received).
- Limit exposure: pilot valid for onboarding only. Any future expedited requests need Finance/Procurement sign-off.

I’ve attached the Accelerated Pay policy excerpt. Rafael — please confirm the PO number and issue the PO with the GL code above. I’ll inform AP to expect two expedite invoices and to apply the 1% fee routing procedure.
